title: Classic French Omelette
subtitle: Tender, golden rolled omelette with soft curds
description: A classic French-style rolled omelette featuring delicate, creamy curds and a smooth, unbrowned exterior. Cooked gently over low-medium heat in under 7 minutes.

ingredients.name: Butter or cooking oil
ingredients.notes: Clarified butter or extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Position pan
steps.instruction: Place your 8-inch non-stick skillet flat and centered on the stovetop burner over medium-low heat.
steps.tip: Center the pan precisely over the burner so heat spreads evenly across the cooking surface.

steps.title: Add oil
steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of butter or cooking oil to the warm skillet. Swirl the pan gently to coat the entire base and lower sidewalls.
steps.tip: Wait for butter to foam gently without browning, or for oil to shimmer before adding eggs.

steps.title: Add eggs
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs until completely uniform with no streaks of white, then pour directly into the center of the warm skillet.
steps.tip: The pan should sizzle very gently — if it hisses loudly, lower heat immediately to prevent rubbery eggs.

steps.title: Add salt
steps.instruction: Evenly sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of kosher salt and a light pinch of freshly cracked pepper over the liquid eggs.
steps.tip: Seasoning directly in the warm pan allows salt to dissolve smoothly into forming curds.

steps.title: Stir
steps.instruction: Using a flexible silicone spatula, rapidly stir the eggs in small circular motions while gently shaking the skillet back and forth.
steps.tip: Continuous stirring creates ultra-fine, silky curds. Push cooked curds toward the center so liquid flows to edges.

steps.title: Cook
steps.instruction: Stop stirring and smooth the eggs into an even layer. Let the base set over gentle low heat until the surface is soft and creamy.
steps.tip: The top should look glossy and slightly custard-like. Avoid browning the underside.
steps.requiredAction: Rest on low heat to set

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Tilt the skillet at a 45-degree angle toward your serving plate, fold one-third over, roll cleanly, and slide onto the plate.
steps.tip: Garnish with fresh chives and brush top with a dab of warm butter for a glossy restaurant finish.
